task.title: Pair Your Pulse Bottle with the App
task.shortdesc: Connect your bottle to the Pulse app to track your daily hydration.

context.p: Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your phone before you begin.

step.cmd: Download the Pulse app from the App Store or Google Play.
Open the app and tap Add Device.
Press and hold the cap button for three seconds until the display ring flashes blue.
Tap your bottle's name in the list of nearby devices shown in the app.

taskbody.result: Your bottle is paired and will automatically sync your water intake to the app.
